categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in smart transportation and smart government sectors. Its key business lines include large-scale application of Beidou satellite navigation technology, Beidou free-flow tolling systems, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and smart governance solutions. It also provides data products, security management, and low-carbon transformation solutions leveraging technologies like AI, big data, blockchain, and IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include Beidou high-precision satellite navigation, AI large models and agents, real-time dynamic positioning (RTK, RTD), vehicle-road-cloud integration (C-V2X), blockchain for data certification, and multi-modal AI for intelligent document and data processing. The company develops hardware such as Beidou smart terminals integrating Beidou chips and AI imaging chips, and software platforms for intelligent risk control, data analysis, and digital governance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies (e.g., Shanghai and Beijing archives, Shanghai and Beijing judicial systems), transportation departments, logistics companies, insurance firms, and enterprises in smart city and smart agriculture sectors. The company serves markets in smart transportation, digital government, food safety traceability, and intelligent infrastructure management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant business in East China (notably Shanghai and Zhejiang), North China (Beijing), South China (Hainan), Southwest China, and other regions. It has subsidiaries and projects in multiple provinces and cities, including strategic pilot projects in major cities like Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It develops and deploys terminal hardware (Beidou smart terminals), integrates software platforms, and provides data services and intelligent solutions to end users such as government bodies, transportation operators, and enterprises. It also collaborates with upstream chip suppliers for Beidou chips and AI chips.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI empowerment with proprietary AI large models and AI agents, expanding Beidou satellite navigation applications, advancing vehicle-road-cloud integration, and enhancing smart governance and digital city solutions. R&D focuses on multi-modal AI, intelligent risk control models (ASLM), high-precision positioning, intelligent infrastructure monitoring, and distributed computing architectures for AI deployment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through system integration projects, technology support and services, application software development and sales, and terminal service fees. The company also employs data monetization models, including data sharing with insurance companies for risk control and revenue sharing. It offers SaaS subscriptions, project-based fees, and licensing of AI modules and platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading smart transportation and smart government technology provider in China, leveraging its early mover advantage in Beidou satellite navigation and AI integration. It competes with other technology firms in smart city, AI, and IoT sectors, maintaining strong market share in digital archives, smart judicial systems, and intelligent transportation infrastructure. Its strategic partnerships and proprietary technologies create high entry barriers for competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 269 million, a 9% increase from 2023, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 118 million, showing a 36% improvement year-over-year. Total assets were about RMB 1.19 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders around RMB 460 million. The company is in a growth and transformation phase, expanding terminal deployment and data monetization while improving operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique 'Beidou+AI' dual-core technology advantage, offering high-precision positioning combined with advanced AI analytics for intelligent transportation and governance. Its solutions provide precise, real-time data for traffic management, vehicle safety, and digital government services, supported by proprietary risk control models and multi-modal AI platforms. The integration of hardware, software, and data services creates a comprehensive ecosystem that enhances operational efficiency, safety, and regulatory compliance for clients.
